findings.current: By then, the energy flowing from Michael Silbert and me had taken an invisible line as its boundary and was surging toward one another.
findings.defect: The singular subject cannot naturally surge toward “one another,” and “surging” changes the opposed auras from facing each other across a boundary to actively rushing forward.
findings.rationale: The source describes the two characters’ respective auras confronting each other with an invisible line between them.
findings.replacement: By then, the auras flowing from Michael Silbert and me were facing each other across an invisible boundary.
findings.source: 어느덧 미카엘 실베르트와 나를 중심으로 흘러나온 기운이 보이지 않는 선을 경계 삼아 서로를 향하고 있었다.

findings.current: At the same time, I sensed dozens of presences shooting toward us at the speed of light.
findings.defect: The draft turns a comparison to rays of light into the literal physical speed of light.
findings.rationale: The construction 빛살과도 같은 속도로 is explicitly comparative rather than a precise claim about their velocity.
findings.replacement: At the same time, I sensed dozens of presences shooting toward us as swiftly as rays of light.
findings.source: 그와 동시에 이곳을 향해 빛살과도 같은 속도로 쏘아지는 수십의 인기척이 느껴졌다.

findings.current: “You seem to be feeling better now.”
findings.defect: Michael is commenting that the situation or atmosphere has improved after Jin retracts his aura, not expressing concern for Jin’s well-being.
findings.rationale: The line immediately follows Jin reining in his aura, and 한결 낫군 marks approval of the resulting de-escalation.

findings.current: A powerful armed organization that disregarded every country and restriction would fall into the hands of a monster wearing a human face.
findings.defect: The draft replaces Michael’s public disguise as a hero with the unrelated image of a monster wearing a human face, losing the contrast between his heroic reputation and true nature.
findings.rationale: 영웅의 탈 specifically means a hero’s mask or guise; the distinct “human skin” image appears later in the chapter as 인두겁.
findings.replacement: A powerful armed organization that disregarded every country and restriction would fall into the hands of a monster wearing a hero’s mask.
findings.source: 어떤 국가와 제약도 무시하는 강력한 힘을 가진 무력 단체가, 영웅의 탈을 뒤집어쓴 괴물의 손아귀에 들어가는 것이다.

findings.current:
The next moment, following the fury that had seized my entire body, I thrust out my fist, infusing it with the killing intent that had risen alongside it.

*Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.*
findings.defect: The two impact and rushing-air sound effects accompanying the punch are omitted.
findings.rationale: 후웅 and 콰아아 are separate audible beats between the launched punch and the technique name and should be preserved like the chapter’s other sound effects.
findings.replacement:
The next moment, following the fury that had seized my entire body, I thrust out my fist, infusing it with the killing intent that had risen alongside it.

*Whoom! Roooar!*

*Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.*
findings.source:
다음 순간 나는 전신을 사로잡은 분노를 따라, 동시에 함께 일어난 살기(殺氣)를 실어 주먹을 내뻗었다.

후웅. 콰아아!

멸염신권(滅炎神拳).

findings.current: At this moment, I forgot everything to my anger and entrusted everything to it.
findings.defect: “Forgot everything to my anger” is unidiomatic English and obscures the deliberate repetition of anger as both the cause of his oblivion and the force to which he surrenders.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves both clauses and the repeated causal role of 분노 while reading naturally in English.
findings.replacement: At that moment, I forgot everything in my rage and surrendered everything to it.
findings.source: 지금 이 순간만큼은 분노에 모든 것을 잊고, 분노에 모든 것을 맡겼다.

summary: One major characterization error and several localized action, nuance, and prose issues.
